Abbie’s World Composer

One score for every world

Original music written as code and performed by a recorded chamber orchestra. Every piece quotes Abbie’s motif, beds open up in layers as play gets busier, and stings land on the beat in whatever key is playing.

Now playingNothing yetPick a bed below

Beds loop forever, four layers each

Loading…

Stings fire on the next beat, in the bed’s key

Interludes title cards and bridges between beds

How it’s made

Each cue is a score in tools/composer: tempo, key, voicings and lines written note by note. A sampler performs it with the VS Chamber Orchestra Community Edition (CC0) in a synthetic concert hall, then it is mixed to stems, mastered to a loudness target and folded into a seamless loop. Every cue keeps its brief, score, recipe and file hashes in its provenance.
